notes: Exact model measured on AE 2026 8 bpc (full 0..255 LUT on opaque pixels, 0 mismatches in the 3 visible settings, semi-transparent pixels exact too): un-premultiply, t = (c - Input Black) / (Input White - Input Black), clamp t to 0..1, out = Output Black + (Output White - Output Black) * t^(1/Gamma), re-premultiply; alpha untouched; fully transparent pixels stay 0. Level values are AE raw units 0..1 (the UI shows 0..255 in 8 bpc). AE rounds exact halves up (Output White 0.9 -> 229.5 -> 230): the shader adds 1e-6 before the 8-bit quantisation so f32 lands on the same side (checked against the double-precision LUT for the visible settings and gamma 1.4 / 0.1..0.9 input). Not measured against an AE render (no reference): Channel 2/3/4 (levels applied to Red/Green/Blue only) and 5 (Alpha only: the straight colour is kept and re-premultiplied with the levelled alpha, so transparent pixels can gain alpha); ExtendScript only exposes the 5 values of the channel shown in the popup, the other channels' hidden values are assumed identity. Clip To Output Black/White = Off (1) extrapolates beyond Input Black/White (t < 0 uses a sign-preserving power -- assumption), 2 = On and 3 = 'Off for 32 bpc Color' both clip (the Rive canvas is 8 bpc, AE in 32 bpc would keep values outside 0..1). Histogram (2) and Compositing Options (10) are not image parameters. Rive: the remaining +-1 errors come from the Rive pipeline itself (an identity Levels in Rive already differs from src by +-1 on 3.7 % of pixels, mean 0.007).
